segments.name: Wireless Power Network
segments.description: Develops and sells RF wireless power transmitters, receivers and software that charge battery-free IoT devices for retail, industrial, healthcare and logistics customers.
segments.evidence: Our WPN technology consists of transmitter systems, receiver integrated circuits, and supporting software designed to deliver power and data to battery-free IoT devices across a range of operating distances and power levels.

revenueModel.text: Customers and value-chain partners pay for transmitter systems, receiver integrated circuits, power amplifier ICs and the supporting software that powers battery-free IoT devices.
revenueModel.evidence: We pursue an ecosystem-based approach by engaging customers for our transmitter, receiver, and power amplifier ICs and solutions, as well as their upstream and downstream value-chain partners.
